name: Workshop Command Center
actions: cast an attributed exact-digest steward vote
pause continue finish or cancel a saved direction
open one of five parent workspaces
summary: A beginner-first one-page cockpit above the five Workshop parents for planning, exact-digest steward review, lifecycle control, health, evidence, and navigation.
notes: Presentation and explicit request surface only. It never auto-votes, starts Body Pulse, executes generic POST controls, grants permissions, promotes, releases, writes Mirror, or acts on the world.
